title: Safe Haven Fellowship
field: Scholarship, literature, journalism and the arts (scholars and cultural actors at risk)
about: Five-month NIAS fellowship for scholars and cultural actors at risk, with a monthly stipend. Applications for the first semester of 2027-2028 are accepted via the online form until 14 December 2026 at noon CET.
requirements: Scholarly proposals: PhD and at least three years of postdoctoral research experience
Literary, journalistic or artistic proposals: bachelor's degree and at least seven years of professional experience
Applications only through the online form

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Scholarly proposals: PhD and at least three years of postdoctoral research experience" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
"Scholarship, literature, journalism and the arts" (field) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
